_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — edit only this file. All components read from it.

vulnbox.note: ssh_user/ssh_port = team patch key, only reaches this team's public-proxy container (no tcpdump there). capture_ssh_alias = admin SSH (via ~/.ssh/config, ProxyJump to gameserver) used by deploy-capture-pull.sh to tcpdump on the docker HOST. capture_iface (default "eth0"/auto) is the EXTERNAL interface, captured pre-NAT so each service's public port (services[].port) is what both tcpdump's BPF and Tulip see directly -- no docker_bridge / capture_port NAT workaround needed. Set docker_bridge only if eth0 genuinely is not where the public IP lives (rare; auto mode tries ip route first).

monitor_host.bind_ip_note: Address the control-plane ports (dashboard, redis, tulip, postgres, ioc-brain, mcp, anythingllm) listen on. 127.0.0.1 = only this machine (safe default: the monitor host sits on the competition VPN, and these ports have no auth). Set to a LAN IP only to let teammates on a trusted network open the dashboard. The honeytoken port always listens on all interfaces by design.

flag.note: PUT with header X-Team-Token: <team token, kept OUT of this file — see team-tokens.txt locally>

gameserver_hint.note: ForcAD scoreboard; PUT /flags with X-Team-Token header to submit

honeytoken.note: a fake flag placed in a trap file on the vulnbox; if seen outbound it means compromise

tulip.note: Tulip stores flows in TimescaleDB/Postgres, not Mongo — see mcp.postgres_ro_uri

mock_vulnbox.note: false = real vulnbox (DFCD practice arena, team-01). bringup.sh skips the toy app + ctf_proxy when false.

ctf_proxy.note: keyword MUST stay the single source other tools read from — do not hardcode elsewhere

mcp.note: postgres_host_port is Tulip's timescale container, exposed to host so mcp-tulip (on ctf-net) can reach it; bringup.sh builds the full URI using the same DOCKER_HOST_GATEWAY resolution as ioc-brain's Ollama access

ollama.note: load on demand only; never keep resident. gpu_layers=20 fits ~2.5GB VRAM for Q4_K_M 8B. host: empty = Ollama runs on this same machine (bringup.sh auto-probes a reachable gateway); set to a real LAN IP (e.g. 192.168.1.50) to point at a dedicated LLM machine instead — see docs/REMOTE_LLM.md

services.name: web
services.note: team-03 public-proxy -> DFCD app stack (php/ws/mathsays). Capture is now on the external interface (pre-NAT), so port 8003 (the public port) is what both tcpdump and Tulip see directly -- no capture_port override needed.

retention.note: host_agent deletes captured pcaps in traffic/ (oldest first) only when needed: traffic/ grows past pcap_max_gb, or the disk has less than min_free_gb free. pcap_keep_minutes > 0 additionally deletes anything older than that (0 = off). Files younger than 10 min are never touched. Flows already imported stay in Tulip. On the vulnbox, pcaps are removed as soon as they are pulled.
